articles.title_en: A leak from Russia’s federal statistics agency made it possible to estimate the country’s military death toll in the war against Ukraine. What else did it reveal?
articles.lead_en: At least 700,000 Russian service members have died in the war against Ukraine. Journalists from Meduza and Mediazona reached that figure using data that the hacker groups Belarusian Cyber Partisans and Silent Crow obtained when they broke into a database belonging to Rosstat, Russia’s federal statistics agency.

articles.title_en: Ukraine invokes U.N. Charter in defense of its strike on Russian warship in Libya
articles.lead_en: Kyiv says the strike on the Russian corvette Merkuriy off the coast of Libya did not expand the war’s geographic scope but was simply an exercise of Ukraine’s lawful right to self-defense. Ukraine “isn’t dragging anyone into the war or spreading it anywhere else,” Foreign Ministry spokesperson Heorhii Tykhyi said Tuesday.
